name: narrated-design-walkthrough
description: Generate derivative Slidev walkthroughs with curated TTS narration from canonical engineering design docs. Turns docs/design or docs/plans Markdown into an audio-first, phase-aware narrated walkthrough.
versionPolicy: patch (1.0.x) = SKILL.md improvements only, no project changes needed; minor (1.x.0) = _addon/ files updated, users must copy new templates to docs/walkthroughs/_addon/; major (x.0.0) = breaking _addon/ API change, users must re-bootstrap from scratch.
